gt_gate.distance: Euclidean distance between two GT centres in the (v,w) plane
gt_gate.threshold_origin: Existing v2 gauge_soft interval, fixed before this full rerun; not a surveyed tolerance
gt_gate.inputs: Two derived GT centres only; no predictions, confidence, errors, run or frame identity

reference_coordinates: Original median-v/q75-w centres retained verbatim. No replacement, snapping or relabelling.
rejected_reference: Excluded only from checked numerical scores; retained in raw scores and coverage counts.
split_note: Retrospective regression on already inspected data, not a new independent test.
